title: run_dublin_grown is the 5th hand-rolled Demo_Replay construction plus a 5th copy of the per-tick command-batch loop — the sibling copies have already drifted (r1 note, unfixed by the fold)
location: harness/dublin_shot.odin:147-171 (cf. harness/overlay.odin:174-183, harness/run.odin:321-340, harness/run.odin:764-800, harness/motion_strip.odin:72-82, harness/dublin_shot.odin:187-193)
detail: Five copies of the Demo→Demo_Replay field-copy + slice-clone + tick-batch plumbing; three of the four older copies have already diverged in which run-setup fields they carry. The duplication demonstrably breeds divergence; the fold added a fifth instead of extracting.
recommended_fix: Extract demo_replay_from_demo(demo: ^Demo) -> Demo_Replay (field copy + nodes/spawns/pauses clones) beside parse_demo, and a shared play-to-ticks helper; migrate all five sites.

title: District live counts re-derived O(districts² × nodes) per spawn attempt — Dublin's 52 districts pay a full board re-scan per district per cluster per attempt (r1 note, unfixed)
detail: The measured side of the cap contract is quadratic in district count and re-derived per attempt though it changes only when a spawn lands. A per-window census array alongside the existing lazy cluster-view build removes the quadratic at equal outcome.
recommended_fix: Once per spawn window (beside the lazy gview build), run ONE pass over live terminals building a per-district count array; eligibility and the W1 check then read it O(1).

title: map_board_partition's allocator parameter threads only the outer array — the inner per-district lists silently bind context.allocator
detail: A caller passing a scoped arena owns only the outer shell; the inner lists land on context.allocator. Harmless today only because Odin's delete honors each array's stored allocator — the parameter's implied contract is half-true.
recommended_fix: Pre-make each inner list with the passed allocator (e.g. make([dynamic]u32, 0, 4, allocator) per district) so append grows on it, or document that the parameter covers only the outer array.

title: seed_weights hard-codes [6]i32 against District_Kind — a future 7th kind compiles and loads with the struct-zero weight 0 (band silently excluded), contradicting the loader's fail-fast contract
detail: Nothing ties the array size to the enum cardinality. Adding a district kind (the documented extension path — kinds are baked data) silently reads as band-excluded instead of erroring, the exact silent-zero the loader comment claims is impossible.
recommended_fix: Use an enum-indexed array (seed_weights: [District_Kind]i32 — a new kind becomes a compile error) or pre-init all weights to -1 and require every kind explicitly set before the range check.

title: district_kind_name's doc claims the render's label tier reads the enum — the approved render carries no district labels; the harness audit is the sole consumer
detail: The comment names a second consumer that does not exist — the label tier was removed from the approved render. A maintainer tracing render dependencies from this comment is misled about the module boundary.
recommended_fix: Reword the comment to name the real consumer (the harness spawn audit's label) and drop the render claim.
